hints.title: Convex Cost Landscape
hints.text: The sum of Euclidean distances to a collection of points forms a strictly convex function in 2D space.

hints.title: Center of Mass Initialization
hints.text: Initialize search at the centroid (average x, average y) of all customer locations.

hints.title: Step Halving Optimization
hints.text: Sample four cardinal directions at step distance delta. If a step reduces distance, move there; otherwise halve delta until precision reaches 1e-7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Geometric step halving converges exponentially to the global minimum of the convex distance objective.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Analytical solutions (Fermat-Weber point) have no closed algebraic form and require numerical convergence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative step halving requires only two coordinate variables, executing in constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Convex optimization via gradient descent, Weiszfeld algorithm, or ternary/step-halving search.
